✨ tabatha | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Improving the efficiency and user experience of managing multiple Chrome browser tabs.
✨ Key Features: • Live tab previews • Search open and recently closed tabs • Reopen recently closed tabs and windows • Unified view of tabs across all windows • Support for tab groups
📖 Summary: Tabatha is a Chrome extension that enhances tab management by providing live previews of all open tabs, enabling quick searching, and facilitating easy switching and reopening of closed tabs. It aims to replicate the familiar Alt+Tab functionality for web browser tabs.
